prompt: A trial codec saves delivered bytes at equal quality, but few viewers can decode it. What should decide whether to add that encode?

options.text: Total video views, regardless of device support
options.explanation: Wrong. Incompatible viewers keep receiving the older codec and do not produce the trial saving.
Wrong. A one-off cost must be compared with future savings and other added costs.

options.text: Compatible future watch time and measured savings, compared with all extra costs
options.explanation: Correct. Count the views that can receive the encode, along with compute, storage and operational costs.

options.text: A universal rule that CPU always costs more than bandwidth
options.explanation: Wrong. The balance depends on workload, hardware, prices and viewing volume.

workedExample: Measure quality and bitrate on representative content. Estimate compatible watched minutes and price their saved bytes. Compare that benefit with the extra encode, storage and operational costs. More views help only when those views actually receive the new codec.
